# @emisso/sii (discontinued)

> `@emisso/sii`, `@emisso/sii-api`, and `@emisso/sii-cli` are discontinued. They are no longer maintained and will receive no new versions. Existing published versions, source, history, and the MIT license remain available.

For new integrations, use Notta's [REST API](https://notta.cl/docs/api-reference) or [MCP](https://notta.cl/docs/mcp). These services are not drop-in replacements for SDK imports or the self-hosted API.

`@emisso/registry-cl` is outside this retirement. This notice adds no maintenance commitment for that package; the monorepo is not being archived.

- Repo: https://github.com/emisso-ai/emisso-sii
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@emisso/sii
- License: MIT

## Historical installation

Retained for users of existing versions, not recommended for new integrations.

npm install @emisso/sii

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/emisso-ai/emisso-sii/blob/main/README.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/emisso-ai/emisso-sii/blob/main/AGENTS.md)

## Historical SDK design

The following descriptions record the former API design, not a claim of complete functionality. Some functions remain unimplemented and throw `Not implemented`. SDK examples, roadmap, and design documents are historical reference, not planned work.

- Authenticate with SII using .p12 digital certificates (SOAP token exchange)
- Build, sign, and submit electronic documents (DTE)
- List received and issued invoices via RCV (Registro de Compras y Ventas)
- Download RCV data as CSV
- Folio management (CAF files)
- Self-hosted REST API with certificate vault and multi-tenant support (@emisso/sii-api)

## Historical API reference

- `loadCertFromFile(path, password)` — Load .p12/.pfx certificate
- `authenticate(cert, options)` — SOAP auth, returns SII token
- `buildDteXml(document)` — Build DTE XML from structured input
- `signDte(xml, cert)` — Sign DTE XML with certificate
- `uploadDte(xml, token, options)` — Submit signed DTE to SII
- `listInvoices(options)` — Fetch RCV invoice listing
- `fetchRcvResumen(options)` — RCV summary by period
- `downloadRcvCsv(options)` — Download RCV as CSV
- `portalLogin(rut, password)` — Web portal session login
